pages.title: Rack and temperature
pages.text: The rack is an 11-slot TFC container: 8 biological slots, 2 stackable leaf-feed slots and 1 egg output slot. Eggs hatch into silkworms after 2–4 in-game days when the rack temperature is at least 0 °C. The rack keeps its contents and lifecycle data through saves and chunk reloads.

pages.title: Feed and lifecycle
pages.text: Put Firmalife fruit leaves or A-owned mulberry leaves in the feed slots. Each suitable day consumes one leaf from the stacked feed slots and adds one growth point; 10 growth points make a cocoon. Without feed, hunger rises once per day and the silkworm is removed at 3 hunger. A cocoon left in the rack becomes an adult after 3–5 suitable days. Adults live about 7 in-game days.

pages.title: Breeding and processing
pages.text: Two or more adults in the rack produce 1–5 eggs each day when the output slot has room. For silk processing, put a cocoon and 100 mB water in a TFC pot at 300 °C for 60 seconds to make one cooked silkworm; extra water remains. Combine cooked silkworm with a TFC spindle to make one B silk thread and damage the spindle. Weave 24 B silk threads in the TFC loom to make one tfc:silk_cloth.
Rack recipe: 3 lumber over two rod posts and a lumber base.

pages.title: Silkworm egg
pages.text: Hatches after 2–4 suitable days at 0 °C or warmer.

pages.title: Cocoon
pages.text: Produced at 10 growth points; becomes an adult after 3–5 suitable days.

pages.title: Silk thread
pages.text: Cooked silkworm + spindle → one silk thread; 24 threads weave one silk cloth.
